A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same complete, readable 15-page NoRD paper, including supplementary Sections 7–13. Pages 2–15 render identically; page 1 differs only in the arXiv version/date stamp.

before.justification: v1 reports original NAVSIM and WaymoE2E experiments, GRPO versus Dr. GRPO comparisons, and supplementary vocabulary-size ablations and failure analyses.

after.justification: v3 retains the same original benchmark results, optimization comparisons, ablations, and supplementary analyses.

M1.justification: Section 4 retains the same Qwen-2.5VL-3B backbone, trajectory tokenization, supervised fine-tuning, and Dr. GRPO post-training procedure. Inputs, objectives, clipping, and reward components are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same NAVSIM and WaymoE2E trajectory-prediction tasks and driving scenarios, including the same scenario categories in supplementary Table 6.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical throughout Tables 1–4. This includes Poutine, HMVLM, DiffusionLTF, UniPlan, and AutoVLA on WaymoE2E, the same NAVSIM baselines, and the GRPO versus Dr. GRPO comparisons.

E3.justification: Sections 5 and 10–11 retain identical data splits, preprocessing, model configurations, training budgets, rollout settings, and evaluation procedures. PDM, RFS, ADE, and best-of-six evaluation are unchanged.

E4.justification: The reward-distribution and variance-group analyses in Figures 2–3 and 10–11, vocabulary-size ablation in Table 5, and qualitative failure cases in Figure 13 are identical.

E5.justification: Figure 2 retains the same group-standard-deviation reporting, and Table 3 retains the same description of six outputs generated with different random seeds. No run-count disclosures, uncertainty-reporting practices, or statistical tests change.

E6.justification: All numerical and qualitative results match. Tables 1 and 4 retain NAVSIM PDMS values of 76.66, 77.18, and 85.62 for the base, GRPO, and Dr. GRPO models; Table 2 retains NoRD's RFS of 7.709 and ADE@3 of 1.2504.

T1.justification: The advantage and optimization equations in Section 4.2 and reward definitions in supplementary Section 9 are identical. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical claims about reasoning-free, data-efficient driving, difficulty bias in GRPO, and applying Dr. GRPO to autonomous driving.

C2.justification: The difficulty-bias interpretation and qualification that language reasoning may still benefit VLAs are unchanged. Section 13 retains the same discussion of failures and residual difficulty bias in Dr. GRPO.

D1.justification: Sections 5.2 and 9–12 retain the same hyperparameters, hardware, software, data filtering, reward construction, and dataset-scale estimation details. Code and data access information is unchanged.

R1.justification: The same 51 references and related-work discussion appear in both PDFs. Positioning relative to reasoning-based and reasoning-free VLAs and difficulty-bias mitigation is unchanged.

P1.justification: Only the first-page arXiv margin stamp changes from v1 dated 24 February 2026 to v3 dated 5 June 2026. The title, authors, body prose, terminology, and section organization remain identical.

P2.justification: Figures 1–13 and Tables 1–6 retain identical content, captions, axes, legends, formatting, and placement. The main and supplementary page layouts are unchanged; the margin-stamp text update does not reorganize the layout.

improvement.justification: The supplied PDFs contain identical scientific content, experimental evidence, explanations, reproducibility information, and limitations, including the supplement. Updating the arXiv version/date stamp produces no meaningful difference in overall paper quality.
